name: Michelle Ramirez
bio:
Michelle's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, replacing a sick co-worker at a carbon fiber manufacturing plant that supplied parts to various racing teams. She quickly became captivated by the precision and artistry required to craft high-performance composite components. Her meticulous nature and unwavering commitment to quality allowed her to master the intricacies of lay-up techniques, vacuum bagging, and autoclave curing, eventually earning a coveted position at Anderson Racing.

At Anderson Racing, Michelle is known for her no-nonsense approach and relentless pursuit of perfection. She believes that even the smallest flaw can compromise performance, and she holds herself and her team to the highest standards. While some may find her demanding, her unwavering dedication has earned the respect of her colleagues, who appreciate her expertise and commitment to excellence. Michelle's keen eye for detail and innovative problem-solving skills make her an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring that their cars are always at the forefront of composite technology.

Beyond the technical aspects, Michelle is passionate about mentoring young technicians, instilling in them the importance of precision, patience, and unwavering dedication to their craft. She believes that the future of motorsport depends on cultivating the next generation of skilled professionals, and she takes pride in shaping the careers of those who share her passion.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, pulled back in a tight ponytail
physical.description: Michelle is a strong woman of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect composite surfaces.
Insists on using only a specific brand of resin, claiming it provides superior results.
Sharpens her pencils to an almost dangerous point.
